title.narrative: Tajikistan Strengthening Water and Irrigation Management Project

description.narrative: The project development objective is to: (i) strengthen capacity for water resources planning and irrigation management in Tajikistan and (ii) improve performance of selected irrigation schemes in the Vakhsh and Zarafshon river basins.
